create_robot_interface: create a RobotInterface instance to connect to a gRPC Polymetis controller server at a given IP and port
move_to_joint_positions: move the robot to desired joint positions using a JointGoToPolicy with adaptive time-to-go
move_to_ee_pose: move the robot end-effector to a desired position and orientation using inverse kinematics and operational space interpolation
start_joint_impedance: start a non-blocking joint impedance controller for continuous joint position control with updateable desired positions
get_ee_pose: get the current end-effector pose as a 3D position and 4D quaternion orientation via forward kinematics
